title: Fully Prepared Chicken Sandwiches

onscreen_lines.desc: The proposed chicken sandwich shall be fully cooked, ready to serve upon delivery, and require no additional preparation by district staff. Each sandwich shall be individually wrapped or packaged to maintain food safety and product quality, meet all applicable USDA Smart Snacks requirements, and be produced, handled, and transported in accordance with all applicable federal, state, and local food safety regulations.
onscreen_lines.note: The District anticipates an estimated usage of approximately 2,600 fully prepared chicken sandwiches per week. Nutrition Standards: • Total calories: 350 or less • Sodium: 480mg or less • Total fat: 35% of calories or less • Saturated fat: less than 10% of calories • Trans Fat: 0g • Total sugars: 35% by weight or less
